podcast.title: Camila Cabello's Departure and Disbandment
podcast.body: In 2016, Camila Cabello left Fifth Harmony to pursue a solo career. The remaining quartet released only one more album before disbanding. Cabello went on to become a chart-topping soloist with hits like "Havana." "Later that year, Cuban American singer Camila Cabello broke away from Fifth Harmony for a solo career. The remaining quartet put out only one more album before disbanding."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Eliminated but Signed
podcast.body: Like One Direction before them, Fifth Harmony competed on "The X Factor" but came in third, failing to make the final round. Despite this, Simon Cowell signed them to a recording contract. "Fifth Harmony competed on the show as a quintet and came in third, failing to make the final round. But Simon Cowell signed them to a recording contract anyway."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Formed on The X Factor
podcast.body: Fifth Harmony was formed by Simon Cowell on the American edition of "The X Factor" in 2012, bringing together solo vocalists Normani Kordei, Lauren Jauregui, Ally Brooke, Dinah Jane, and Camila Cabello after a joint audition. The quintet's name was given by a viewer vote. "In 2012, Simon brought together solo vocalists Normani Corday, Lauren Hareghi, Ali Broke, Dina Jane and Camila Cabello for a joint audition that impressed the X Factor judges. After a viewer vote, the quintet was given the girl group name Fifth Harmony."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
